title: Divine Nine Special Registration Plate Act
lastAction: Ref to the Com on Transportation, if favorable, Finance, if favorable, Rules, Calendar, and Operations of the House
aiSummary: This bill creates a new Sigma Gamma Rho Sorority special registration plate in North Carolina and sets its additional fee at $20. The bill also clarifies how fees from Divine Nine fraternity and sorority plates are distributed, directing a portion of Sigma Gamma Rho plate fees to the Sigma Gamma Rho Sorority National Education Fund.
aiProArguments: Supporters argue this bill provides equal representation for Sigma Gamma Rho Sorority among North Carolina's Divine Nine special plates, as the other eight organizations already have plates available. The bill generates revenue for the sorority's educational foundation while allowing members to display their organizational pride on their vehicles, similar to existing options for other Greek organizations.
aiConArguments: Opponents may question whether creating additional special registration plates is the best use of state resources, or whether it sets a precedent for many other organizations to request similar plates. Some may also raise concerns about whether the $20 fee structure and revenue distribution are appropriate compared to other special plates, or whether state government should be involved in promoting specific private organizations.
